api.title: Phonos API Documentation
api.introText: The Phonos API gives programmatic access to our structure prediction and sequence generation models, for example Boltz-2 and Evo 2. Use it to integrate Phonos into your own applications and workflows.
api.authText: All API requests (except /v1/health) require authentication using an API key. You can create and manage API keys in your dashboard settings.
api.authHeader: Include your API key in the Authorization header of each request:
api.keepKeySecureText: Never commit API keys to version control or expose them in client-side code. Treat them like passwords.
api.rateLimitText: API keys have configurable rate limits. When you exceed your rate limit, you'll receive a 429 Too Many Requests response. Rate limits are enforced per API key, not per user.
api.backoff: Implement exponential backoff when you receive 429 responses
api.cacheResults: Cache results when possible to reduce API calls
api.batchOps: Use batch operations if your workflow allows
api.monitorUsage: Monitor your rate limit usage in the dashboard
api.healthDesc: Check API health and status. This endpoint does not require authentication.
api.listModelsDesc: Retrieve a list of AI models known to the API. Retired models may still be listed.
api.submitPredictionDesc: Submit a new prediction job to be processed asynchronously.
api.modelId: Model ID (for example boltz2 or evo2)
api.proteinSeq: Protein sequence (amino acids) or SMILES (for diffdock)
api.modelSpecificParamsDesc: Each model accepts different optional parameters in the params object to customize the prediction.
api.esmfoldDesc: Retired on 2026-08-25. Kept here for reference only; use Boltz-2 or OpenFold3 in the web app.
api.numRecycles: Number of recycling iterations (1-24). Higher values may improve accuracy but take longer.
api.chunkSize: Controls memory usage. Reduce if running into memory issues.
api.esmfoldBestFor: Reference only: this model no longer runs.
api.alphafold2Desc: Retired on 2026-09-24. Kept here for reference only; use Boltz-2 or OpenFold3 in the web app.
api.maxMsaSeqs: Maximum number of MSA sequences to use
api.useTemplates: Whether to use template structures from PDB
api.alphafold2BestFor: Reference only: this model no longer runs.
api.diffdockDesc: The self-hosted DiffDock node has been retired. Kept here for reference only; use DiffDock-RE in the web app.
api.proteinPdb: PDB file content or path to protein structure
api.ligandSmiles: SMILES string of the ligand molecule
api.inferenceSteps: Number of diffusion steps (10-40). Higher = more accurate but slower.
api.samplesPerComplex: Number of binding poses to generate
api.diffdockBestFor: Reference only: this model no longer runs.
api.getJobStatusDesc: Retrieve the status and results of a prediction job.
api.downloadResultsDesc: Download the output file (PDB format) for a completed job.
api.accountInfoDesc: Get your account information including credit balance and job statistics.
api.listJobsDesc: List all your jobs with optional filtering by status or model.
api.filterStatus: Filter by status: pending, running, completed, failed
api.filterModel: Filter by model, for example boltz2 or evo2
api.offsetResults: Number of results to skip for pagination
api.batchPredictDesc: Submit multiple prediction jobs in a single request (max 10 jobs per batch).
api.cancelJobDesc: Cancel a pending or running job.
api.apiUsageDesc: Get detailed API usage statistics including requests by endpoint, model, and daily breakdown.
api.webhooksDesc: Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when jobs complete or fail, eliminating the need to poll for status updates.
api.listWebhooksDesc: List all configured webhooks for your account.
api.createWebhookDesc: Create a new webhook to receive job status notifications (max 5 per account).
api.webhookUrl: HTTPS URL to receive webhook events
api.webhookEvents: Events to subscribe to: job.completed, job.failed, job.started
api.deleteWebhookDesc: Delete a webhook by its ID.
api.testWebhookDesc: Send a test event to verify your webhook endpoint is working correctly.
api.errorDesc: The API uses standard HTTP status codes and returns JSON error objects with helpful messages.
api.unauthorized: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key
api.tooManyRequests: Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded
api.pollEfficientlyText: Use 5-10 second intervals when checking job status. Don't poll more frequently than necessary.
api.batchPredictionsText: Submit multiple jobs in parallel rather than waiting for each to complete.
api.chooseModelText: Use Boltz-2 for structure prediction and Evo 2 for DNA generation. ESMFold, AlphaFold2 and DiffDock have been retired and no longer run.
api.cacheResultsBestText: Store predictions locally to avoid re-computing identical sequences.
api.envVarsText: Store API keys in environment variables, never hardcode them.
api.serverSideOnlyText: Never expose API keys in client-side JavaScript or mobile apps.
api.rotateKeysText: Periodically rotate your API keys, especially after team member changes.
api.separateKeysText: Create different API keys for development and production environments.
api.implementRetriesText: Use exponential backoff for transient errors (500, 503).
api.handleRateLimitsText: Catch 429 responses and wait before retrying.
api.validateInputsText: Check sequence formats and parameters before submitting to avoid 400 errors.
api.logErrorsText: Keep detailed logs of API errors for debugging and monitoring.
api.gracefulDegradationText: Have fallback mechanisms when the API is unavailable.
api.trackUsageText: Monitor your API usage and credit consumption in the dashboard.
api.requestIdsText: Log job IDs for all predictions to trace issues.

trustedTester.title: Trusted Tester Program
trustedTester.intro: Trusted Testers use Phonos before it opens to everyone, tell us what breaks, and then move on to regular access.
trustedTester.stepApplyText: Tell us what you want to test.
trustedTester.stepTestText: Approved testers get access and report findings.
trustedTester.stepRegularText: Testers join regular access when the program ends for them.
trustedTester.applied: Application received. We will email you when it is reviewed.
trustedTester.pendingText: Your application is waiting for review. You will get an email and a notification as soon as it is decided.
trustedTester.approvedText: You are a Trusted Tester. Please report anything that breaks or confuses you through the help desk; we move testers to regular access when their testing phase ends.
trustedTester.graduatedText: Thank you for testing Phonos. Your account has regular access.
trustedTester.optInText: You already have regular access. Join as a Trusted Tester to try new features first.

trustedTester.legalNote: By applying you accept the Trusted Tester terms and we process your application as described in the privacy policy.
